_description: Multi-step ETL input example — simplified rskm_fields (3-variant risk metric computation + merge). Demonstrates DROP→CREATE→INSERT chain with mutually-exclusive population segments merged via COALESCE.

sources.description: Base account data with scores and balances
Fallback risk parameters for low-score accounts

code_artifacts.content:
/* Risk Score Computation Pipeline */

/* Step 1 - Normal risk score computation */
drop table work_db.risk_normal;

create set table work_db.risk_normal (
  account_id DECIMAL(16,0) NOT NULL,
  risk_score DECIMAL(16,8)
) unique primary index (account_id);

insert into work_db.risk_normal
  select
    ab.account_id,
    1/(1+EXP(
      (rp.score_weight * ab.behaviour_score)
      + (rp.balance_weight * CASE WHEN ab.credit_limit = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE CAST(ab.balance AS DECIMAL(18,10)) / CAST(ab.credit_limit AS DECIMAL(18,10)) END)
      + rp.intercept
    )) as risk_score
  from s_acctdb.account_base ab
  inner join r_refdb.risk_params rp
    on ab.scorecard_id = rp.scorecard_id
  where ab.behaviour_score > 31
    and ab.status_code NOT IN ('A','B','X');

/* Step 2 - Fallback risk score for low-score accounts */
drop table work_db.risk_fallback;

create set table work_db.risk_fallback (
  account_id DECIMAL(16,0) NOT NULL,
  risk_score DECIMAL(16,8)
) unique primary index (account_id);

insert into work_db.risk_fallback
  select
    ab.account_id,
    rpf.default_score as risk_score
  from s_acctdb.account_base ab
  inner join r_refdb.risk_params_fallback rpf
    on ab.delinquency_code = rpf.delinquency_code
  where ab.behaviour_score <= 31
    and ab.status_code NOT IN ('A','B','X');

/* Step 3 - Merge risk scores + derive band */
drop table work_db.risk_merged;

create set table work_db.risk_merged (
  account_id DECIMAL(16,0) NOT NULL,
  risk_score DECIMAL(16,8),
  risk_band  CHAR(1),
  exposure_value DECIMAL(16,8)
) unique primary index (account_id);

insert into work_db.risk_merged
  select
    drv.account_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) >= 0.9999995
         THEN 0.999999
         ELSE COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) END as risk_score,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) < 0.003 THEN '1'
         WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) < 0.012 THEN '2'
         WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) < 0.050 THEN '3'
         WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) < 0.100 THEN '4'
         WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) < 1     THEN '5'
         ELSE NULL END as risk_band,
    CASE WHEN drv.credit_limit > drv.highest_balance
         THEN drv.credit_limit
         ELSE drv.highest_balance END as exposure_value
  from s_acctdb.account_base drv
  left join work_db.risk_normal rn
    on drv.account_id = rn.account_id
  left join work_db.risk_fallback rf
    on drv.account_id = rf.account_id;

/* Step 4 - Final target insert */
insert into t_riskdb.risk_metrics
  select
    rm.account_id,
    rm.risk_score,
    rm.risk_band,
    rm.exposure_value,
    CURRENT_DATE as load_date
  from work_db.risk_merged rm;
